headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Could Be 14% Undervalued As Content Reset Comes Into Focus
headlines.summary: Netflix (NFLX) has reshaped its content buying bench by promoting Craig Ferguson to director of content acquisition in Los Angeles, following a year on the team and a long tenure cutting licensing deals across Hollywood. Netflix shares have slipped around 9% on a 30 day share price return and are down about 23% year to date, while the 1 year total shareholder return has dropped roughly 42% despite a near doubling over three years.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
